name: GCP
label: Google Cloud APIs
description: Google Cloud APIs via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://cloud.google.com/apis. Operations: object_get, object_put, object_delete, object_list, pubsub_publish, pubsub_pull, run_invoke, functions_call, compute_get, gke_get, secretmanager_get, iam_get, listen. Auth secret access_token is instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). listen/trigger are kind:ingress — use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. JDK HTTP, official API only.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path params such as id match api_spec.json placeholders.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: object_get | object_put | object_delete | object_list | pubsub_publish | pubsub_pull | run_invoke | functions_call | compute_get | gke_get | secretmanager_get | iam_get | listen. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen/trigger are ingress: they do not call HTTP — use a BPMN message event. Example: 'object_get'.

schema.label: bucket
schema.description: GCS bucket.

schema.label: object
schema.description: Object name. File payloads type file.

schema.label: topic
schema.description: Pub/Sub topic id.

schema.label: alt
schema.description: Query-string parameter `alt` for operation: object_get.

schema.label: uploadType
schema.description: GCS upload type for object_put. EXACT: media | multipart | resumable. Default media. Example: media.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Query-string parameter `name` for operation: object_put.

schema.label: prefix
schema.description: Query-string parameter `prefix` for operation: object_list.

schema.label: pageToken
schema.description: Query-string parameter `pageToken` for operation: object_list.

schema.label: messages
schema.description: pubsub_publish PubsubMessages: [{data: base64, attributes:{}, orderingKey}]. Official PublishRequest.messages.

schema.label: subscription
schema.description: URL path parameter `subscription` for operation: pubsub_pull. Required by: pubsub_pull.

schema.label: maxMessages
schema.description: Request-body parameter `maxMessages` for operation: pubsub_pull.

schema.label: service_host
schema.description: URL path parameter `service_host` for operation: run_invoke. Required by: run_invoke.

schema.label: location
schema.description: URL path parameter `location` for operations: functions_call, gke_get. Required by: functions_call, gke_get.

schema.label: function
schema.description: URL path parameter `function` for operation: functions_call. Required by: functions_call.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Cloud Functions v1 :call request.data — a JSON-encoded string the function receives as its event payload. Official field name (not a generic blob). Used by functions_call. Example: {"ok":true}.

schema.label: zone
schema.description: URL path parameter `zone` for operation: compute_get. Required by: compute_get.

schema.label: instance
schema.description: URL path parameter `instance` for operation: compute_get. Required by: compute_get.

schema.label: cluster
schema.description: URL path parameter `cluster` for operation: gke_get. Required by: gke_get.

schema.label: secret
schema.description: URL path parameter `secret` for operation: secretmanager_get. Required by: secretmanager_get.

schema.label: version
schema.description: URL path parameter `version` for operation: secretmanager_get. Required by: secretmanager_get.

schema.label: email
schema.description: URL path parameter `email` for operation: iam_get. Required by: iam_get.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Object bytes for object_put (uploadType=media raw body) and optional raw body for run_invoke. Platform file block {mime_type, source, data, name}.

schema.label: contentType
schema.description: MIME type query for object_put (also sent as Content-Type). Example: application/pdf.

schema.label: returnImmediately
schema.description: pubsub_pull: when true, return even if no messages. Official returnImmediately.

schema.label: content
schema.description: Object bytes for object_put (alias of file) and optional raw body. Platform file block {mime_type, source, data, name}.

schema.label: url
schema.description: Cloud Run service URL for run_invoke (alias of service_host). Example: https://my-service-xxxx.run.app.

schema.label: resource
schema.description: IAM resource name or service account email for iam_get (path). Example: my-sa@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: HTTP Status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: object_get, object_put, object_delete, object_list, pubsub_publish, pubsub_pull, run_invoke, functions_call, compute_get, gke_get, secretmanager_get, iam_get, listen. listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: OAuth access token (or minted SA token). SA JSON stays in the secret manager; OfficialApiNode cannot mint JWT — bind a short-lived access token.

configurationParameters.label: location
configurationParameters.description: Default Cloud Functions / GKE location when INPUT location is empty. Example: us-central1.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon stateful budget (~300s).

configurationParameters.label: Content
configurationParameters.description: Object bytes for object_put (alias of file) and optional raw body. Platform file block {mime_type, source, data, name}.

configurationParameters.label: Url
configurationParameters.description: Cloud Run service URL for run_invoke (alias of service_host). Example: https://my-service-xxxx.run.app.

configurationParameters.label: Resource
configurationParameters.description: IAM resource name or service account email for iam_get (path). Example: my-sa@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com.
